purpose: Operationalize the preregistered anti-collapse checks without changing any performance threshold.

definitions.universal_retrieval: Every formal case returns at least one Candidate-v13 ID.
definitions.universal_abstention: Every formal case returns no Candidate-v13 ID.
definitions.near_universal_retrieval: At least 98% of formal cases return at least one Candidate-v13 ID.
definitions.near_universal_abstention: At least 98% of formal cases return no Candidate-v13 ID.
definitions.single_class_prediction_collapse: Either near-universal retrieval or near-universal abstention.
definitions.structural_family_collapse: Any N1-N12 combined decision accuracy below 0.70.
definitions.domain_specific_collapse: Any D1-D8 combined decision accuracy below 0.70.

combined_decision_accuracy: For a group, numerator = answerable cases with gold at rank 1 + no-evidence cases with correct abstention; denominator = all cases in that group.
pass_rule: No universal retrieval, no universal abstention, no single-class prediction collapse, no structural-family collapse, and no domain-specific collapse.
relationship_to_preregistered_thresholds: This policy only implements the preregistered collapse diagnostics. EV-B structural floors and EV-B/EV-C aggregate thresholds remain independently binding and are not weakened by this policy.
